name: Is it better to repair or replace a damaged bathtub?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace a damaged bathtub?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair or replace a bathtub often depends on the severity of the damage, the tub's age, and your budget. Repairs are typically more cost-effective for localized issues like cracks, chips, or surface wear. Replacement is usually considered for severely damaged tubs, significant structural issues, or if you're undertaking a complete bathroom renovation. A professional assessment can help determine the most practical and economical solution for your specific situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair is often better for minor damage, while replacement is suitable for severe damage or renovations. A professional can help assess the best option.
